name: wmkf_potentialreviewers-bibliometric
_comment: appresearcher collapse (S213, docs/archive/APPRESEARCHER_COLLAPSE_PLAN_V2.md). Folds the wmkf_appresearcher 1:1 bibliometric sidecar's fields onto the person so reviewer identity + bibliometrics live in one row (the sidecar + the two empty publication tables are dropped after caller switchover). 17 fields — the sidecar's 24 wmkf_* attrs minus 2 structural (PK, lookup) and 5 skips: wmkf_name (collision, person's wins — D0.3), wmkf_email (dup of wmkf_emailaddress alt-key — D0.4), wmkf_normalizedname (no consumer — D0.5), wmkf_notes (0 rows — D-NOTES), wmkf_potentialreviewername (denormalized name copy — D-DENORM). wmkf_PrimaryAffiliation (500) becomes the canonical reviewer affiliation per D-AFF (replaces the 100-char wmkf_organizationname; readers migrate in Phase 4). ORCID is NOT made an alternate key here (most rows null; person dedupes on wmkf_emailaddress). Collision-checked 2026-06-02: none of these logical names exist on wmkf_potentialreviewers (only wmkf_name collides, which is skipped). Idempotent: ensureAttribute checks existence before create. Deploy: node scripts/apply-dataverse-schema.js --target=prod --wave=6 --execute

attributes.description: Reviewer's institutional affiliation (canonical, per D-AFF — replaces the 100-char wmkf_organizationname). Free text.
Reviewer's department within their institution (e.g. 'Department of Chemistry'). Captured by reviewer search/enrichment and by reviewer self-correction at accept; used in staff write-ups.
Where the email came from (orcid, scholar, manual, etc.).
Last time the row's bibliometric data was reviewed/refreshed.
Last refresh of citation metrics (h-index, citations).
Last time the reviewer's contact info was enriched.
